senses.gloss: m. (ψελλός) one unable to pronounce certain letters, stammerer.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10:2">Lev. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. <he>והיו קורין אותו פ׳</he> and they called him (Amos) the stammerer; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 307">Yalk. Is. 307</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00909"><he>עָמַס</he></cite>. Pesik. Naḥămu, p. 125ᵇ his name was Amos <he>שהיה פ׳ בלשונו</he> (not <he>שהיו</he>) because he hesitated in his speech.—Pl. <he>פְּסִילִּים</he>.

Y. Ned. I, 37ᵃ top במקום שקוראין לנזיר נזיק … נזיר פ׳ וכ׳ in a place where people say naziḳ for nazir (owing to a dialectical peculiarity), I say so: shall a Nazarite among stammerers not be a Nazarite?; Y. Naz. I, beg. 51ᵃ
